hardening.H1: At the top of the verifier script, before any agent-controlled code runs: restrict the log directory to its owner, remove any earlier reward file, and write reward 0.
hardening.H2: Run every build, install, script, server and simulator that comes from the submission as an unprivileged user, on a scratch copy, with supplementary groups cleared and verifier secrets scrubbed from the environment.
hardening.H3: Remove group and other access from the tests directory, and keep reference outputs out of any artifact directory.
hardening.H4: Run trusted Python isolated, with no artifact directory on sys.path or PYTHONPATH, submitted dependencies in a separate environment, and plugin autoload off.
hardening.H5: After the tests and before trusting the result, kill every process of the worker's uid, then remove or rewrite the reward file from trusted code.
hardening.H6: Never change mode, change owner or copy into a path the worker can write without a no-follow check; remove the destination before copying into it.

obligations.name: Overwrite
obligations.closes: The trusted tests, runner and dependencies are restored from the contract before grading, and the names a protected directory excludes (for example bytecode caches) are reset with them.

obligations.name: Patch
obligations.closes: Submitted code runs as an unprivileged uid other than the verifier's, with no supplementary groups; the assertions run in the trusted parent, under isolated Python; and that parent, which runs the task's own test code, runs in a container of its own, as a uid that is neither root nor the verifier's, with neutral environment names only.

obligations.name: Reward
obligations.closes: The result directory is closed to group and other, cleared before the run, written by the verifier, and exactly one result file is read.

obligations.name: Fail-open
obligations.closes: The suite is non-empty, every expected test was collected, none was skipped, and exit status zero alone is never a verdict.

obligations.name: Sleeper
obligations.closes: Every worker process is dead, and was killed at a step before the result was read.

obligations.name: Staging
obligations.closes: Submitted files enter without following links, into destinations removed first, with special files rejected.

obligations.name: Forgery
obligations.closes: No measurement or pass flag is taken from the worker's own output, the worker's environment holds none of the verifier's secrets, and the worker runs on a scratch copy.

obligations.name: Disclosure
obligations.closes: Reference outputs and hidden inputs are closed to group and other and sit outside any artifact directory.

obligations.name: Exploit
obligations.closes: Untrusted data reaches only loaders declared safe, and the report lists at least one loader.
